subTitle: Precision Masking
title: Rotoscope
text: Rotoscoping involves creating detailed mattes to isolate subjects or elements in live-action footage. It's a vital process for seamless compositing in VFX pipelines.

subTitle: Cleanup & Restoration
title: Paint Prep
text: Paint Prep is the process of removing unwanted elements like rigs, markers, and wires. It ensures the footage is clean and ready for advanced VFX integration.

subTitle: Digital Retouching
title: Cosmetic Fixes
text: Cosmetic Fixes enhance on-screen appearances by digitally correcting skin, wardrobe, and makeup while preserving the natural look of the performance.

subTitle: Scene Integration
title: Compositing
text: Compositing merges all visual elements—live-action, CGI, and effects—into a single seamless shot. It's where the magic of VFX truly comes together.

subTitle: Camera & Object Tracking
title: Matchmove
text: Matchmoving is the process of tracking camera or object motion in live footage, allowing CGI elements to be placed realistically within a scene.

subTitle: Shot Planning
title: Pre-Visualisation
text: Pre-visualisation helps directors and VFX teams plan complex scenes ahead of production using 3D animation, storyboards, and virtual cameras.

subTitle: Visual Enhancement
title: Color Grading
text: Color Grading enhances the visual tone of a film, establishing mood and continuity. It balances exposure, contrast, and color to achieve cinematic quality.

subTitle: Layer-Based Effects
title: 2D
text: 2D visual effects include screen replacements, particle effects, and graphic elements composited directly onto the footage without 3D interaction.

subTitle: Three-Dimensional Assets
title: 3D
text: 3D VFX covers the creation and animation of digital models, environments, and effects integrated seamlessly with live-action footage.

subTitle: Concept Development
title: Concept Art
text: Concept Art visualizes key scenes, characters, and environments before production, helping align the creative vision and guide the VFX process.

subTitle: On-Set Expertise
title: VFX Supervision
text: VFX Supervision ensures that all visual effects requirements are captured on set, coordinating between the production and post-production teams.

subTitle: AI-Powered Creativity
title: AI Generation
text: AI Generation uses cutting-edge artificial intelligence to create realistic and imaginative visual content, streamlining the creative process from concept to final product
